title: Pulp Fiction
synopsis: A briefcase. A boss's wife. A boxer who didn't throw the fight. You're a hitman in a bad suit. The day has, so far, been long.

nodes.text: You and Vincent. The briefcase glows. The kid in the chair, sweating.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Style.
There is no taking “Skip the verse” back. Speed shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Vincent shoots Marvin by accident. The car is a disaster. You drive.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Friend—follows you into whatever comes next.
You commit to “Drive to Marsellus.” The story records the instinct as “Direct” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Coffee, calm, a man named the Wolf. He has thirty minutes.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Foolish.

nodes.text: You and Vincent in a diner. You decide, today, what kind of man you want to be.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Stay in” back. Familiar shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Two amateurs robbing the diner. You hold them at gunpoint, briefly.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Style.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Cold.

nodes.text: Vincent has, tonight, dinner with Marsellus' wife.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Behave perfectly.” The story records the instinct as “Discipline” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Risk.

nodes.text: Twist contest. You dance. You almost forget the briefcase.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Joy.
There is no taking “Lose with style” back. Cool shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Mia thinks your bag is something else. She overdoses.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Save.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Civic.

nodes.text: You stab the needle into her heart. She comes back screaming.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Survive.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Switching tracks: you are now Butch. Your father's watch is at your apartment.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
There is no taking “Leave it” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You shoot Vincent as he comes out of your bathroom. The watch is in your hand.

choices.consequence: “Take the watch and go” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Survive.
There is no taking “Stand frozen” back. Human shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Marsellus, on the street. You hit him with your car. You both end up in a pawn shop.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: The owner has a gimp. The owner has a problem with you and Marsellus both.

choices.consequence: “Free Marsellus” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Right.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Practical.

nodes.text: A katana on the wall. You take it.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Style—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Marsellus owes you. He tells you to leave LA forever.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.
There is no taking “Negotiate” back. Greedy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Fabienne packed everything except your father's watch. She is, you realize, going to be okay.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Love.
You commit to “Be cold.” The story records the instinct as “Stress” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You and Fabienne ride out of LA on Zed's chopper. The sun comes up.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Sentiment—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Don't look” back. Forward shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Back at the diner. The robbery is happening now. You and Vincent are in a booth.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Discipline—follows you into whatever comes next.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cold—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The robber wants your wallet. You pay him to leave. You realize you are, finally, walking the earth.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honor—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Vincent decides to stay in. You decide to walk.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Familiar—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The briefcase is delivered. Whatever is in it stays in it. You don't, today, open it.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.
You commit to “Hand it over.” The story records the instinct as “Job” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You walk the earth, like Caine. You end up running a small diner in New Mexico. The food is, by year three, surprisingly good. People come from town just for the eggs.
nodes.sceneTitle: The Path of the Righteous Man
nodes.endingTitle: The Path of the Righteous Man

nodes.text: You never learn what was in it. Marsellus pays you. You buy a small apartment building. You become a landlord. You are, against every expectation, good at it.
You stay in. The work continues. Vincent dies. Marsellus retires. You are, eventually, the oldest man in the rooms you walk into. You die in one of them, with a smile.
